title: Experiment Tree
description: EXECUTE-stage artifact. Output of experiment-tree-explorer. Explores a bounded tree of next-run branches within the controlled variable space. Each branch declares the variables it touches and its depth. The tree declares a budget_bound capped by task_frame.budget. The variable-touch-guard reads touched_variables on each branch.

tree_id.description: Unique identifier for this experiment tree.

root_run_ref.description: Reference to the root run_record this tree expands from.

branches.description: The candidate next-run branches. May be empty if the explorer finds no admissible branches in the budget.

branch_id.description: Unique identifier for this branch within the tree.

changed_factors.description: The factor settings that differ from the root in this branch.

touched_variables.description: Experiment variables (from experiment_matrix) this branch would touch. Read by variable-touch-guard.

depth.description: Tree depth of this branch (root = depth 1).

max_depth.description: Maximum tree depth allowed, capped by task_frame.budget.

max_width.description: Maximum number of branches per level, capped by task_frame.budget.

evidence_ref.description: Evidence references (run_records, experiment_matrix) supporting the tree design. Anti-slop: at least one non-empty reference required.
